doc.title: Chubby Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998

title: Closing thanks
summary: Thanks, a hope for Part Two, and Chubby's tribute to his wife.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well listen, I never myself am going to look at the equation X plus Y equals Z the same again.
Thank you. It makes sense though, doesn’t it?
It does. And this has really been absolutely a fascinating hour and a half or whatever.
Well thanks, Monk, for me too.
I have a feeling if we get out this way, we’re going to have to do Part Two.

I’d love it. I’m very grateful and thankful for the opportunity to say things, because you know age is starting to pile up, and if I have an opportunity every now and then to be something which was Chubby. You know, it’s a groove for me too, man.
Thanks so much for your time.
Oh, man it’s been a pleasure, Tim, everybody. My wife is the inspiration of my life.
